description: Aantal afsluitingen na LAC beslissing is a dataset listed in Fluvius open data portal, an open data portal of a distribution network operator, published or maintained by Fluvius (Flanders). Deze dataset bevat het aantal afsluitingen na positief advies van de lokale advies commissie. De dataset is geaggregeerd per rapporteringsjaar/maand, per gemeente, per markt. De punten zijn verdeeld in beschermde en niet beschermde klanten en het totaal cijfer van beide groepen. Coverage: Belgium (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Fluvius als leverancier. Its keywords are Lokale advies commissie, Aardgas, Elektriciteit, Gemeente. The portal shows 2026-09-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open data license - FLUVIUS (https://opendata.fluvius.be/p/licentieopendatafluvius). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-fluvius-open-data-portal.
